title: Voice, Habit, Hint: Dandadan in Three Clues
description: Ten guess-from-clues questions. Most start with the Japanese voice actor, then a habit or trait, then a strong hint; the last one is a season. Light spoilers up to Season 2.
notes: Clues format: clue 1 is the Japanese voice actor (or the closing song), clue 2 a habit or trait, clue 3 a strong hint; not a plain who-is-who.

questions.question: Who is this character?
clues: In the Japanese version, she is voiced by Nana Mizuki.
She hosts a television show where she tells fortunes, and it has made her rich.
She looks about twenty, yet she is Momo's grandmother.

questions.question: Which yokai is this?
clues: In Japanese, this yokai is voiced by Mayumi Tanaka.
Long ago, she was a gentle presence for the ghosts of girls who met a terrible end.
Seiko locks her spirit inside a lucky cat doll.

questions.question: Which aliens are these?
clues: Kazuya Nakai is their Japanese voice.
They come from a planet of their own and have no females at all.
They kidnap people from Earth to get body parts they lack.

questions.question: Who is this character?
clues: In Japanese, she is voiced by Ayane Sakura.
She is sure that heaven picked her to drive out yokai.
At Kami High, she is the idol of the school.

questions.question: Who is this character?
clues: Kaito Ishikawa is his Japanese voice.
He looks like a handsome athlete, but he is a goofy soul who praises everyone.
He is Momo's childhood friend and ends up living with her and Seiko.

questions.question: Which yokai is this?
clues: His Japanese voice is Mutsumi Tamura.
Hot water calms him down, and cold brings his power back.
He was born from a human sacrifice and later bonds with a boy.

questions.question: Who is this character?
clues: Daichi Fujiwara is his Japanese voice.
He keeps hitting on girls, who reject him almost every time.
His love of aliens makes him the best user of nanoskin.

questions.question: Who is this character?
clues: In Japanese, Tomokazu Sugita voices him.
He is a living anatomical model.
He lives at the high school of Momo and Okarun and is madly in love with Hana.

questions.question: Who is this character?
clues: She is a strict class representative.
In private she is a secret fan of vampires.
Her gravity powers are tied to her singing.

questions.question: Which season is this?
clues: Its ending song is Doukashiteru by WurtS.
Its opening song is Kakumei Dochu by Aina the End.
It began in July 2025.
